analyst.summary: SBFC Finance is a secured-lending NBFC focused on MSME loans and, increasingly, gold loans. The business is growing at a healthy clip -- loan book up 29% and profit up 31% for the year -- while asset quality is improving and the company remains very well capitalized, with capital levels roughly double what regulators typically require. That combination of growth, improving asset quality, and a strong capital cushion supports a more constructive view than the pure quant score alone.
